data.title: 小岭幸 · 寂静书库的梯前偶遇
data.description: 美浜学园高耸深邃的古典藏书室内，数米高的深色实木书架排成幽深的走廊。幸身穿美浜学园紫衫白裙制服，踩在移动木梯的第二阶上，正踮起脚尖从顶层书架取下一本精装童话书。那是她与雄二童年共同回忆的证明。微风穿透百叶窗吹起她的百褶裙摆，她低头看着在梯下守候的雄二，眼眶泛红带着无限依恋。
data.location: 古老高顶图书馆木质藏书阁梯架旁
data.action: 踩在移动木梯上单手取下书架顶层厚书，制服裙摆微拂，低头温柔凝视下方
data.lighting: 百叶窗斜射入的丁达尔金黄光束与书架深处的古典暗调
data.camera: wide shot, low angle, both figures and library ladder visible
data.promptProse: Sachi stands on the second rung of the library ladder in her lavender uniform and white pleated skirt. One hand steadies her while the other draws down the storybook, and she looks toward Yuuji. He waits at the foot in a white collared shirt and dark trousers, his short black hair striped by the afternoon light through the blinds.
data.animaCaption: Pink-haired Sachi braces on the second ladder rung in her lavender blouse and white skirt, pulling down a book. Yuuji waits at the foot in a white shirt and dark trousers, his short black hair in profile as he looks up.
